description: Re-retention of 4 COL-033 YouTube payloads (HHBD 224, H4CBH 395, CBN 468, CRDH 352) from their verified Desktop location. No new collection; hashes and record counts verified identical to 20261015-youtube-csv-adoption.json before staging. Private retention: git_tracking ignored (raw-social-default, raw-data-policy §5.6). This declaration re-retention does not Git-track the payload and does not include it in any release archive.

runs.purpose: Re-retention of the COL-033-adopted payload at its verified new location (owner instruction 2026-11-06; no new collection, no new observation). Original entry: ISS-20261015-COL-033 formal adoption (owner-approved 2026-10-15): HHBD リキッド YouTube dataset export 14-19-47

temporal.boundary_semantics: observed video publish-date range in payload; not the API condition
limitations: date_filter is the API request parameter (a relative rolling window resolved by the collector); window.start/end_exclusive is the observed video publish-date range in the payload and must not be treated as the API search condition (owner direction 2026-10-15)

timestamps.basis: Apify console Runs list provided by owner 2026-10-15 (JST display converted to UTC); filename stamp agrees within 2s

reretention.note: Desktop file digest and CSV record count match the adopted payload byte-for-byte; bytes, run ID and observation conditions unchanged.

retention.basis: raw-data-policy §5.6 default for YouTube (raw-social-default); owner 2026-11-06: copyright/redistribution grounds, raw non-public, local or private retention; no Git tracking, no release archive inclusion.
